verdict.rationale: Cline explicitly supports JetBrains IDEs and documents that edits in JetBrains show up as reviewable/revertable diffs (cline-gh-1, cline-docs-6, cline-docs-28), covering the interactive diff part of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'share selected code as context' feature specifically for the JetBrains plugin (only general chat/context usage is implied), so the second half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit JetBrains-specific documentation or screenshots of selecting code and adding it as context, independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow in JetBrains.
